_comment: CANONICAL cross-repo fixtures for applying methodological filters (§3.11).
The CATALOGUE itself — strings, publishers, citations, validated flags — is data,
pinned in the generated shared-surface.json. These cases cover the one piece of
BEHAVIOR: how a filter attaches to a query.
The load-bearing case is `wraps the query in parentheses`. A hedge is a chain of
ORs; AND'ing it onto an unwrapped query rebinds the operators and silently
changes what the search returns — the exact failure a filter is supposed to
prevent. Every string was also executed against the live API on 2026-08-01.

cases.name: wraps the query in parentheses before AND'ing the filter
an exclusion filter attaches with NOT, not AND
a multi-line framework query is flattened first
an empty query yields the filter alone, parenthesised
an exclusion filter with no query yields nothing, not a bare NOT
ERIC field syntax passes through untouched
ClinicalTrials.gov AREA syntax passes through untouched
the Cochrane trial filter attaches whole, operators intact
cases.expected: (asthma) AND (randomized controlled trial[pt] OR controlled clinical trial[pt] OR randomized[tiab] OR placebo[tiab] OR clinical trials as topic[mesh:noexp] OR randomly[tiab] OR trial[ti] NOT (animals[mh] NOT humans[mh]))
